description: Recorded model settings for the paper; source code currently released for LIBERO-Pro. Model identifiers must be available through the selected provider.

active_passive_comparison.evaluations: Eight scene seeds with two repetitions per task.
active_passive_comparison.resource_settings: The first two passive rounds for goal-t00 and goal-t03 predate the token-target gate. Subsequent runs use token targets. Goal-t05 uses a separate provider and reasoning setting.
active_passive_comparison.token_accounting: Actual cumulative Meta usage includes cached/uncached input, output, and sub-agent tokens.
active_passive_comparison.private_endpoints: Not distributed; configure an available provider locally.
